description: Convert text into natural-sounding speech using AI voices. Supports 70+ languages and 200+ voices. Returns an audio URL and/or base64-encoded MP3 audio data, along with credits consumed and remaining.

pitch.description: Speech pitch (-50 to 50, default 0). Positive = higher, negative = lower.

rate.description: Speech rate/speed (-50 to 50, default 0). Positive = faster, negative = slower.

text.description: The text to convert to speech (max 20,000 characters)

voice_id.description: Voice ID, e.g. "voice-001" (Jenny, English Female). Use the list_voices tool to discover available voices.

volume.description: Speech volume (-50 to 50, default 0). Positive = louder, negative = quieter.

name: text_to_speech
title: Text to Speech
